book.name: Matoosa Mishiraachcho
book.title: Matoosi Xaafida Nu Godaa Yesus Kirstoosa Mishiraachcho Qaala

content: Yesusa Kaalliza Tammanne Nam7ata Kiiteteth
Yesusi bana kaalliza tammanne nam7ata baakko xeygidi, istti tuna ayanata kessana mala qasseka sakoppenne hargefe paththana mala isttas godateth immides.
Tammanne nam7u Hawaareta sunththay hayssafe kaallizayssa; koyroy Phexroosa geetettiza Simoona, iza ishaa Indiraasa, Zabdoosa naa Yaaqoobenne iza ishaa Yohannisa,
Piliphoosanne Bartelemoosa, Toomaasanne qaraxa shiishshiza Matoosa, Ilfiyoosa naa Yaaqoobenne Tadoosa,
ba baggas mishettiza Simoonanne
guyeppe Yesusa hayqos aaththi immida Asqoronto
Yuhuda.
Hayta tammanne nam7ata ubbaa, «Ayzaabeta giddo boopite; Samaariya asaa katama gelopite.
Gido attiin Isra7eele deraa garsafe dhayda dorsatakko biite.
Biidinne, ‹Salo kawoteththi matides!› giidi sabbakite.
Harganchchata paththite, hayqqidayta hayqoppe denththite, inchchirachcha hargizayta geeshshite; daydanththata kessite; intte mela ekkidayssa mela immite;
worqqa, bira woykko xarqimala gidiin intte kiisen oykkofte.
Oosanchchas hachchis hachchis gidizaaz koshshiza gishshas intte oges giidi shinqe, koshshontta may7o, caamma woykko guufe ekki boopite.
«Issi katama woykko issi guta intte geliza wode inttena mokkanaade koyi demmidi iza keeththan shempite; heeppe kezana gakkanaas heen diishshite.
Intte oona keeththika gelshe, ‹Saro› giite.
He keeththay sarotay bessiza keeththe gidikko intte sarotay he keeththaas gido; sarotay bessontta keeththe gidikko intte sarotay aggi inttes simmo.

Ay asikka inttena mokki ekkanaassinne intte gizaa siyanaas koyonttaade gidikko hessaade keeththafe woykko he katamaappe kezishe istta bolla yiza gomeppe intte attidayssas markka gidana mala intte toho bolla diza gudulla pittidi kezite.
Ta inttes tumu gays; pirda gallas he katamay bolla gakkana pirday Sodoome bollanne Gamoora bolla gakkida pirdaafe deexo gidana.
«Ta inttena dorsa mala kana suyteta giddora kiittays. Hessa gishshas shooshsha mala cinccatanne haraphphe mala ashketa gidite.
Asay inttena oykkidi pirdiza duulatas shiishshana; Ayhudati ba Woosa Keeththan inttena garafana; hessa gishshas isttafe naagettite.
Ta gaason dere haarizaytakkonne kawotakko inttena efana; istta sinththaninne ammanontta asata sinththan intte markka gidana.
Inttena istti oykkiza wode, ‹Nu ay gi haasaynoo? Wozgi zaaro imminoo?› gi hirgofte. He wode intte gaanaazi inttes imettana.
Inttenan haasayanay intte Aawa Ayanappe attiin inttena gidekketa.
«Ishay ba ishaa hayqos aaththi immana; aaway ba naa bolla, nayti bana yelidayta bolla makkallateththan dendidi hara asan wodhisana.
Ta gishshas asi wurikka inttena ixxana. Gido attiin wurseth gakkanaas minni eqqiday izi attana.
Asay inttena intte diza heeraappe gooddiko haraso kichchite! Ta inttes tumu gays; intte Isra7eele katama ubbaa gakkontta dishin ta Asa Nay yaana.
«Ashkaray godaappe woykko kaallizaadey kaaleththizaadefe aadhdhenna.
Tamaarey bana tamaarsizayssa mala woykko ashkaray ba godaa mala gidikko hessi izas gidana. Keeththa aawa, ‹Bi7elizeebula› giikko iza soo asaa ays hessafe iita geetenne!
«Hessa gishshas isttas babbofte; geemettiday qonccontta qotettiday geesh kezontta attenna.
Ta inttes dhumara yootidayssa poo7on haasayte; hayththan siyidayssa qonccen haasayte.
Asho wodhikkofe attiin shempo wodhanaas dandayonttaytas babbofte; hessafe ashonne shempo gaththi Gaanname taman dhayssanaas dandayzayssas babbite.
Issi santen bayzettiza nam7u siine kafotappe issiniyakka intte salo Aawaa sheney baynda coo kunda attuku.
Haray attoshin intte hu7e binanaykka taybon dees.
Hessa gishshas babbofte. Daro siine kafotappe intte waagay aadhdhi bonchchettidaaza.
«Asa sinththan taas markkattizaades tanikka salon diza ta Aawaa sinththan izaades markkattana.
Qasse asa sinththan tana kaddidaade tanikka salon diza ta Aawaa sinththan iza ta kaddana.
«Tani biitta bolla saroteth ehanaas yidaa inttes misatoppo; mashsha ehanaas attiin saroteth ehanaas yabeekke.
Tani yiday naa aawappe, macca naa aayppe, naa machcho bollotippe shaakkanaassa.
Asas morkkey soo asaa gidana.
«Taappe aaththidi ba aawaa woykko ba aayo siiqizaadey taas gidanaas bessenna. Taappe aaththidi ba attuma naa woykko, macca naa siiqizaadey taas gidanaas bessenna.
Ba masqale tookkidi tana kaallontta asi taas gidanaas bessenna.
Ba shempo ashshanaas koyzaadey dhayssees; ba shempo ta gishshas aaththi immizaadey ashshees.
«Inttena mokki ekkizaadey tanakka mokki ekkees. Tana mokki ekkizaadey tana kiittidaadekka mokki ekkees.
Issi nabe nabeteththan mokki ekkizaadey he nabeza waaga demmana. Xillo as iza xilloteththa gishshas mokki ekkiko he xilloza waaga ekkana.
Hessa gishshas ta inttes tumu gays; oonikka hayta guuththatappe tana kaallizaade gidida gishshas issi xuu7a irxxa haath ushshiko hinniska waagay dhayenna» gides.

footnotes.text: Ba baggas mishettiza Simoona: Hayssi ha sunththay gujettiday issi issi asati izi ba haymanotezas mishettiza gishshassa geettes. Harati qasse izi as aylleteththafe kessiza issi dirjite giddon diza gishshassa geettes.

Asqoronto: Hayssa ha qaalaa gishshas shiiqiza nam7u qofati deettes; issoy Yuhuday Asqoronto geetettiza dereppe yidayssa bessanaas go7ettishin harati qasse Yuhuda wordanchchanne baleththizayssa giidi cayanaas go7ettiza sunththa geettes.
Siine kafo: Siine kafo issi issi bagga Gamoththo qaalan siine gizayssi gaashe kafo guussa.
